name: popup-round
summary: Rounded corners (radius 6 px) for the gray one-line OSD popups of popup-flat

edits.asm: load_corners / corners code and 4 corner glyphs (RLE) in linker padding 0x203D00
sub_253991: jal sub_27BC9C -> jal load_corners (loads 0xFE set, then corners to 0x1C-0x1F)

notes: Loads four quarter-circle glyphs to codes 0x1C-0x1F whenever the vendor loads its base OSD glyph set (sub_253991) and draws them in the four corner cells of the gray popups with attribute 0x10 (foreground 1 = band gray, background 0). Assumes palette index 0 is transparent; if the corners show a colour instead, drop this patch. Generated by tools/patches_src_popup_round.py.
